props.name: disabled
props.description: The trigger does nothing while disabled. Find-in-page still opens it: the browser's behaviour wins.

dataAttributes.name: data-disabled
dataAttributes.description: Present when the part is disabled.

parts.name: CollapsibleTrigger
parts.description: Spread on a <summary> that is the first child of the root's <details>: the toggling, focusability and the expanded state come from that element, and it works on no other. A press asks the root instead of toggling, so a controlled `open` decides and the close can animate.

dataAttributes.name: data-disabled
dataAttributes.description: Present when the part is disabled.

parts.name: CollapsiblePanel
parts.description: The content after the summary. Its size is written to `--collapsible-panel-height` and `--collapsible-panel-width`: px while it opens and closes, `auto` once open. Animate `height` from 0 with both `details:not([open]) > .panel` and `@starting-style` (Chrome needs the second, Safari the first), and to 0 under `[data-ending-style]`.
